data.body: CLUSTER: same root cause as 2eea-e443-270c-4e92 — ticket CLI lookup path is fragmented across commands (transition uses one resolver, show/comment use another, list normalization differs). Fix should centralize ID resolution into a single helper that accepts: (a) UUID short-form like 1d42-ffcb, (b) UUID full-form like 1d42-ffcb-e5a6-4594, (c) Jira-style like jira-dig-2529, (d) user-friendly alias like slid-opera-cabin. Every ticket command should call the central resolver and inherit consistent error contracts (including JSON-on-error so orchestrator parsing does not break).
